title.tr: Can (yetenek, olasılık, fırsat) ve to be ile tanıtım
title.en: Can (ability, possibility, opportunity) and 'to be' for introductions

content.anlatim:
# Alt temalar

Ülkeler (countries) · milliyetler (nationalities) · diller (languages) · başkentler (capitals) · turistik yerler ve aktiviteler · millî günler ve kutlamalar

# İletişim fonksiyonları

- Kendi ülkesini, milliyetini ve dilini **şimdiki zamanda tanıtma**
- **Olasılık ve fırsat** ifade etme
- **Dil yeteneğini** tanımlama

# Grammar A — *can*

*Can* üç temel işlevde kullanılır; ardından fiilin **yalın hâli (V1)** gelir ve tüm öznelerle aynı kalır (*he cans* ❌).

| İşlev | Örnek |
|---|---|
| **Ability** (yetenek) | I **can speak** Turkish, English and German. |
| **Possibility** (olasılık) | The museum **can be** closed today. |
| **Opportunity** (fırsat) | You **can visit** the Maiden Tower in İstanbul. |

| Yapı | Örnek |
|---|---|
| (+) | She **can speak** Japanese. |
| (−) | He **cannot / can't play** the piano. |
| (?) | **Can** you **speak** Azerbaijani? — Yes, I **can**. / No, I **can't**. |

# Grammar B — *to be* (am / is / are)

| Özne | to be | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| I | **am** | I **am** from Türkiye. |
| He / She / It | **is** | She **is** Turkish. · The capital of Japan **is** Tokyo. |
| You / We / They | **are** | They **are** Polish. |

### Ülke → milliyet / dil

| Country | Nationality / Language |
|---|---|
| Azerbaijan | Azerbaijani |
| Poland | Polish |
| Hungary | Hungarian |
| Bulgaria | Bulgarian |
| Norway | Norwegian |
| South Korea | Korean |
| Chile / Peru | Chilean / Peruvian |
| Kazakhstan / Uzbekistan | Kazakh / Uzbek |

ornekler.soru: Boşluğu doldurun: "___ you speak Hungarian?" — "No, I ___ . But I ___ speak Polish."
ornekler.cozum: **Can** you speak Hungarian? — No, I **can't**. But I **can** speak Polish.

ornekler.soru: "You can take a fjord cruise in Norway." cümlesinde *can* hangi işlevdedir?
ornekler.cozum: **Opportunity (fırsat)** — Norveç'te yapılabilecek bir etkinlik öneriliyor.

ornekler.soru: Hatayı düzeltin: "She cans speaks Korean."
ornekler.cozum: *Can* tüm öznelerle aynı kalır ve ardından **V1** gelir → **She can speak Korean.**

ozet: can + V1: ability / possibility / opportunity.
Olumsuz: cannot / can't · Soru: Can + özne + V1?
to be: I am · he/she/it is · you/we/they are.
Ülke ↔ milliyet: Poland–Polish, Norway–Norwegian, Hungary–Hungarian.

title.tr: Kelime, telaffuz, sosyal dil ve beceriler (Theme 1)
title.en: Vocabulary, pronunciation, social language and skills (Theme 1)

content.anlatim:
# Vocabulary

- **Countries:** Azerbaijan, Poland, Hungary, Bulgaria, Norway, South Korea, Chile, Peru, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Turkmenistan, Kyrgyzstan, Thailand…
- **Tourist attractions:** castle, palace, museum, tower, ancient ruin, historical site, tourist attraction, monument, Old Town, thermal baths, rock art, fjord cruise…
- **Activities:** go sightseeing, take a trip, stroll through, explore, visit, hike around a lake…

# Pronunciation

- **"a" sesleri (uzun-kısa ünlüler):** /æ/ (travel, capital) · /eɪ/ (famous) · /ə/ (adventure, Bulgaria) · /ɑː/ (start) · /ɔː/ (warm) · /eə/ (parent)
- **Ünsüzler:** b → /b/ ya da **silent b** (climb, doubt) · c → /s/ (city) veya /k/ (capital) · d → /d/

# Social language

- Hello! / Hi! / Hi there!
- **Let me introduce myself.**
- **This is** Yasemin **from** Türkiye.
- Wow! This palace/tower is excellent/great!
- I like it here/there!
- Let's grab our trays! · Chat about…!

# Skills

- **Listening/Watching:** anahtar kelimeleri tanıma, çıkarım yapma, ayrıntı dinleme, soru sorma-cevaplama
- **Reading:** skimming (genel fikir için hızlı okuma), scanning (belirli bilgiyi arama), jigsaw reading
- **Speaking:** anlamlı ve doğru içerik üretme, ön bilgileri kullanma
- **Writing:** ülke tanıtım metni → **topic sentence + supporting details + conclusion**
- **CLIL & Culture (Roots & Routes):** Türkiye'deki siber güvenlik meslek eğitimi
- **E-Portfolio:** Türkiye'yi tanıtan self-recording / video

ornekler.soru: Skimming ile scanning arasındaki fark nedir?
ornekler.cozum: **Skimming:** metnin **genel fikrini** anlamak için hızlıca göz gezdirmek. **Scanning:** metinde **belirli bir bilgiyi** (tarih, isim, sayı) aramak.

ornekler.soru: Bir ülke tanıtım paragrafının üç bölümü nedir?
ornekler.cozum: **Topic sentence** (ana fikir cümlesi) + **supporting details** (destekleyici ayrıntılar: başkent, dil, turistik yerler) + **conclusion** (sonuç cümlesi).

ozet: Tourist attractions: castle, palace, museum, ancient ruin, monument…
Activities: go sightseeing, stroll through, explore, hike around a lake.
Silent b: climb, doubt · c: /s/ city, /k/ capital.
Let me introduce myself. / This is … from …

content.anlatim:
# Reading: An International Student in Ankara

*Hi! I'm Aiko and I'm from Japan. I'm a student at an international school in Ankara. My classmates are from different countries: Lucas is Brazilian, Dina is Kazakh and Omar is from Egypt. We can all speak English, and I can speak a little Turkish now. On weekends, we can visit many places in Türkiye. Last month we went to Anıtkabir, and next week we can take a boat ride on the Bosphorus in İstanbul. My favourite day is 29 October, Republic Day. The streets are full of flags and everyone is very happy!*

## Okuma Stratejisi

1. **Before reading:** Başlığa ve ilk cümleye bak, konuyu tahmin et.
2. **Skimming:** Metne hızlıca göz gezdir, ana fikri bul.
3. **Scanning:** Sorulardaki anahtar kelimeleri (isim, sayı, yer) metinde ara.
4. **After reading:** Tahminini kontrol et; bilmediğin kelimelerin anlamını **bağlamdan** çıkar.

# Writing Model

**Topic sentence:** *Türkiye is a country with a rich history and beautiful places.*
**Supporting details:** *Its capital is Ankara and people speak Turkish. Tourists can visit Cappadocia, Ephesus and Topkapı Palace. They can also take a boat ride in İstanbul.*
**Conclusion:** *Türkiye is a wonderful country to visit!*

# Performance Task

Bir sınıf arkadaşınla **mülakat** yap: *Where are you from? What is your capital famous for? What can tourists do there? What is your favourite national day?* Cevapları kullanarak kendi ülkeni ya da hayalî bir ülkeyi tanıtan **1 dakikalık bir self-recording** hazırla.

ornekler.soru: Where is Aiko from, and what languages can she speak?
ornekler.cozum: She is from **Japan**. She can speak **English** (and Japanese) and **a little Turkish**.

ornekler.soru: Find the nationality words in the text and write the country for each.
ornekler.cozum: **Brazilian** → Brazil, **Kazakh** → Kazakhstan, (Omar is from) **Egypt** → Egyptian. Nationality adjectives start with a **capital letter** in English.

ozet: Ülke tanıtım paragrafı: topic sentence + supporting details + conclusion.
Milliyet ve dil adları büyük harfle yazılır (Turkish, Brazilian).
can → olasılık/fırsat: Tourists can visit …

title.tr: Simple Present Tense: rutinler ve alışkanlıklar
title.en: Simple Present Tense: routines and habits

content.anlatim:
# Alt temalar

Sınıf arkadaşları · arkadaşlıklar · günlük ve ders rutinleri, alışkanlıklar ve aktiviteler

# Simple Present — kullanım

| Kullanım | Örnek |
|---|---|
| **Habits** (alışkanlıklar) | I always **make** my bed. |
| **Routines** (rutinler) | She **wakes up** at 7 a.m. every day. |
| **General truths / facts** | School **starts** at 8 o'clock. |

# Yapı

| | I / You / We / They | He / She / It |
|---|---|---|
| (+) | I **play** | She **plays** (V1 + **-s/-es**) |
| (−) | I **don't play** | She **doesn't play** |
| (?) | **Do** you **play**? | **Does** she **play**? |

### -s / -es / -ies kuralı

- Çoğu fiil: work → work**s**
- -s, -sh, -ch, -x, -o ile bitenler: watch → watch**es**, go → go**es**
- Ünsüz + y: study → stud**ies** (ünlü + y: play → play**s**)
- **doesn't / does** kullanıldığında fiil yalın kalır: She doesn't **play**s ❌ → She doesn't **play** ✅

# Time expressions

every day · often · always · usually · sometimes · rarely · never · at weekends · on weekdays · twice a week · in the mornings

**Sıklık zarflarının yeri:** asıl fiilden **önce**, *to be*'den **sonra** → *She **usually** walks to school.* / *He **is always** late.*

# Adverbs of manner (tarz zarfları)

carefully · slowly · quickly · neatly → genellikle fiil/nesneden sonra: *She writes **neatly**.*

ornekler.soru: Doğru biçimi yazın: "My brother (study) ___ every evening, but he (not / watch) ___ TV."
ornekler.cozum: My brother **studies** every evening, but he **doesn't watch** TV.

ornekler.soru: Sıklık zarfını doğru yere koyun: "Jacob takes the bus to school. (usually)"
ornekler.cozum: Jacob **usually takes** the bus to school. (Sıklık zarfı asıl fiilden önce gelir.)

ornekler.soru: Soru cümlesine çevirin: "Akio has breakfast at 6:30."
ornekler.cozum: **Does** Akio **have** breakfast at 6:30? (*does* ile fiil yalın: has → have)

ozet: Simple Present: habits, routines, facts.
He/She/It → V1 + -s/-es/-ies.
don't/doesn't + V1 · Do/Does + özne + V1?
Sıklık zarfı: asıl fiilden önce, to be'den sonra.
Adverbs of manner: carefully, slowly, quickly, neatly.

title.tr: Kelime, telaffuz, sosyal dil ve beceriler (Theme 2)
title.en: Vocabulary, pronunciation, social language and skills (Theme 2)

content.anlatim:
# Vocabulary

- **Daily routines:** wake up, make the bed, comb hair, get dressed, have breakfast, leave home, walk / take the bus to school, attend classes, take notes, have a break, leave school, return home, watch TV, work on tasks, go shopping, read a book, go to bed…
- **Study routines:** plan, repeat, set goals, manage time, highlight information, participate in activities…

# Pronunciation

- **e** → /e/ (bed, get) · /æ/ (relax)
- **f** → /f/ · **g** → /g/ (get) veya /dʒ/ (generally) · **h** → /h/ (home)

# Social language

| İfade | Anlamı |
|---|---|
| **Bright and early!** | Sabah erkenden! |
| **I call it a day!** | Bugünlük bu kadar! |
| **Hit the books!** | Sıkı çalışmak, kitaplara gömülmek |
| **I learn by heart!** | Ezberlerim! |
| **Work hard, play later!** | Önce çalış, sonra eğlen! |

# Skills

- **Listening:** *A Typical Day for Jacob* — ayrıntı ve genel fikir dinleme
- **Reading:** *Cultural Differences in Daily Routines* (Akio – Japonya, Lilja – Finlandiya) — skimming, scanning, jigsaw, karşılaştırma
- **Writing:** bir kişinin **hafta içi ve hafta sonu** rutinini karşılaştıran metin (*on weekdays… but at weekends…*)
- **CLIL:** teknoloji destekli eğitim ve çalışma rutinlerine etkisi
- **E-Portfolio:** kendi günlük programını kaydetme

ornekler.soru: "I've finished all my homework. I call it a day!" ifadesi ne anlama gelir?
ornekler.cozum: "Bugünlük bu kadar, işi bırakıyorum." — Günün çalışmasını bitirmek.

ornekler.soru: Hafta içi ve hafta sonu rutinini karşılaştıran iki cümle yazın.
ornekler.cozum: Örnek: *On weekdays, I wake up at 6:30 and take the bus to school. **But** at weekends, I get up late and go shopping with my family.*

ozet: Routines: wake up, get dressed, attend classes, take notes, go to bed.
Study routines: set goals, manage time, highlight information.
g: /g/ get · /dʒ/ generally.
Hit the books! · I call it a day! · Bright and early!

content.anlatim:
# Reading: Ece's Study Routine

*Ece is a ninth grader in İzmir. She always wakes up at 6.30 and takes the bus to school. She attends classes until 3.30. After school, she has a short break and then she hits the books. She usually plans her week on Sundays. She takes notes carefully in class and highlights important points. She rarely studies late at night because she needs to sleep well. On Fridays, she plays volleyball with her friends. "Work hard, play later!" is her favourite saying.*

## Okuma Stratejisi

1. **Before reading:** Başlığa ve ilk cümleye bak, konuyu tahmin et.
2. **Skimming:** Metne hızlıca göz gezdir, ana fikri bul.
3. **Scanning:** Sorulardaki anahtar kelimeleri (isim, sayı, yer) metinde ara.
4. **After reading:** Tahminini kontrol et; bilmediğin kelimelerin anlamını **bağlamdan** çıkar.

# Writing Model

*I usually wake up at 7.00. I never skip breakfast. I take the bus to school and I attend classes until 3.30. After school, I sometimes play football, but I always do my homework first. I study carefully and I take notes neatly. On weekends, I often help my family with household chores.*

# Performance Task

Bir arkadaşının günlük ve ders çalışma rutinini sor (*What time do you…? How often do you…?*). Notlarını kullanarak arkadaşını **üçüncü tekil şahısla** anlatan bir paragraf yaz (*She gets up… He usually…*) ve sınıfa sun.

ornekler.soru: How often does Ece study late at night? Why?
ornekler.cozum: She **rarely** studies late at night because she **needs to sleep well**.

ornekler.soru: Find two adverbs of frequency and one adverb of manner in the text.
ornekler.cozum: Frequency: **always, usually, rarely**. Manner: **carefully** (takes notes carefully).

ozet: Simple Present: rutinler; he/she/it → fiil + -s (wakes, takes, studies).
Sıklık zarfları: always > usually > often > sometimes > rarely > never; genellikle fiilden önce.
Adverbs of manner: carefully, neatly, quickly.

title.tr: Görünüm ve kişilik tanımlama; too & enough
title.en: Describing appearance and personality; too & enough

content.anlatim:
# Alt temalar

Fiziksel görünüm · fiziksel özellikler · kişilik · kişisel özellikler · karakter

# Grammar A — Simple Present ile tanımlama

| Yapı | Örnek |
|---|---|
| **be + adjective** | She **is** medium-height. · He **is** well-built. |
| **have/has + adjective + noun** | She **has** blond hair. · He **has** blue eyes. |
| **look / seem / appear + adjective** | He **looks** handsome. · She **seems** cheerful. |
| **look like + noun** | He **looks like** his father. |

> Soru kalıpları: **What does she look like?** → görünüş · **What is she like?** → kişilik

# Grammar B — too & enough

| Yapı | Anlam | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| **too + adjective** | aşırı, fazla (olumsuz sonuç) | He is **too tall** for this uniform. |
| **adjective + enough** | yeterince | She is **old enough** to drive. |
| **enough + noun** | yeterli miktarda | We have **enough time**. |
| **not + adjective + enough** | yeterince değil | He isn't **tall enough** to play basketball. |

ornekler.soru: Boşluğa *too* veya *enough* yazın: "This box is ___ heavy for me. I'm not strong ___ to carry it."
ornekler.cozum: This box is **too** heavy for me. I'm not strong **enough** to carry it. (*too* sıfattan önce, *enough* sıfattan sonra.)

ornekler.soru: "What is your best friend like?" sorusuna uygun cevap hangisidir: (a) She has long brown hair. (b) She is honest and outgoing.
ornekler.cozum: **(b)** — *What is … like?* **kişiliği** sorar. (a) şıkkı *What does she look like?* sorusunun cevabıdır.

ornekler.soru: Tek cümlede birleştirin: "We have time. We can finish the project." (enough)
ornekler.cozum: We have **enough time** to finish the project. (*enough* isimden **önce** gelir.)

ozet: What does he look like? → görünüş · What is he like? → kişilik.
look / seem / appear + sıfat · look like + isim.
too + adj (fazla) · adj + enough (yeterli) · enough + noun.

content.anlatim:
# Vocabulary

| Physical features | Personality |
|---|---|
| medium-height, plump, slim, well-built | cheerful, honest, friendly, responsible |
| blond, brunette | creative, outgoing |
| attractive, handsome | shy, moody |

- **Appearance verbs:** look (like), seem, appear

### Zıt anlamlılar

shy ↔ **outgoing** · slim ↔ **plump** · cheerful ↔ **moody**

# Pronunciation

- **i** → /iː/ (see, meet) · /ɪ/ (slim, hip) · /aɪ/ (shy, kind)
- **j** → /dʒ/ (just) · **k** → /k/ (kind) · **l** → /l/ (look)

# Skills

- **Reading:** *Charming Personalities, Soft Furs* — skimming, scanning, specific information, gist
- **Writing:** iki tanıdık hayvanı (veya kişiyi) karşılaştırma — *Describing & Comparing* (*Both… / …but… / …while…*)
- **E-Portfolio:** favori kişilerin kişilik ve fiziksel özelliklerini anlatan dijital poster

ornekler.soru: "outgoing" kelimesinin zıt anlamlısı nedir?
ornekler.cozum: **shy** (utangaç). Outgoing = dışa dönük, sosyal.

ornekler.soru: İki kediyi karşılaştıran bir cümle yazın.
ornekler.cozum: Örnek: *Tom is **plump** and lazy, **while** Luna is **slim** and very playful. **Both** of them are friendly.*

ozet: Physical: medium-height, plump, slim, blond, brunette, well-built.
Personality: cheerful, honest, moody, responsible, creative, shy, outgoing.

content.anlatim:
# Reading: Who Is Mr Kaya?

*Mr Kaya is my neighbour. He is middle-aged and well-built. He has short, curly grey hair and a friendly smile. He looks serious at first, but he is very kind and generous. He helps the old people in our street and he is always polite to everyone. He is not shy; he is outgoing and he loves telling funny stories. Some people say he is too talkative, but I think he is cheerful enough to make everyone happy!*

## Okuma Stratejisi

1. **Before reading:** Başlığa ve ilk cümleye bak, konuyu tahmin et.
2. **Skimming:** Metne hızlıca göz gezdir, ana fikri bul.
3. **Scanning:** Sorulardaki anahtar kelimeleri (isim, sayı, yer) metinde ara.
4. **After reading:** Tahminini kontrol et; bilmediğin kelimelerin anlamını **bağlamdan** çıkar.

# Writing Model

*My best friend is Zeynep. She is tall and slim. She has long, straight brown hair and big green eyes. She is clever and confident, but sometimes she is a bit forgetful. She is never rude. She is honest and brave enough to tell the truth all the time.*

# Performance Task

Ailenden, okulundan ya da tanıdığın birinin **fiziksel görünümünü ve kişiliğini** anlatan bir poster ya da **fact file** hazırla; adını yazma. Sınıfta sun, arkadaşların kişinin kim olduğunu tahmin etsin (*Who is he/she?*).

ornekler.soru: What does Mr Kaya look like?
ornekler.cozum: He is **middle-aged** and **well-built**; he has **short, curly grey hair** and a **friendly smile**.

ornekler.soru: What kind of person is he? Find four personality adjectives.
ornekler.cozum: He is **kind, generous, polite, outgoing, cheerful** (also *talkative*).

ozet: What does she look like? → görünüm; What kind of person is she? → kişilik.
too = gereğinden fazla (too talkative); enough = yeterince (cheerful enough).
Sıfat sırası: görünüm (tall, slim) → saç/göz → kişilik.

title.tr: Meslekler ve iş tarifleri; prepositions of place
title.en: Jobs and work descriptions; prepositions of place

content.anlatim:
# Alt temalar

Aile üyelerinin meslekleri · iş rutinleri · iş aktiviteleri · iş yerleri

# Grammar A — Simple Present ile meslek sorma/anlatma

| Soru | Cevap |
|---|---|
| **What does your mother do?** | She **is a** pharmacist. |
| **What does your father do?** | He **works as a** bank clerk. He **serves** customers and **checks** IDs. |
| **Where does he work?** | He works **in a** bank. |

> Meslek söylerken **a / an** kullanılır: *She is **an** accountant.* / *He is **a** nurse.*

# Grammar B — Prepositions of place

| Edat | Kullanım | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| **in** | Kapalı alanın **içinde** | in a bank, in a hospital, in an office |
| **at** | Bir **nokta / kurum** olarak | at school, at a shopping centre, at work |
| **on** | Yüzey, geniş açık alan | on the farm, on a ship |

ornekler.soru: Boşlukları doldurun: "My uncle is ___ accountant. He works ___ an office. My aunt works ___ a farm."
ornekler.cozum: My uncle is **an** accountant. He works **in** an office. My aunt works **on** a farm.

ornekler.soru: "What does your sister do?" sorusunun anlamı nedir ve nasıl cevaplanır?
ornekler.cozum: "Kız kardeşin ne iş yapar?" — **mesleği** sorar. Cevap: *She is a nurse. She works in a hospital.*

ozet: What does … do? → meslek sorusu.
works as a … / is a(n) …
in a bank/hospital · at school/work · on the farm.

content.anlatim:
# Vocabulary

| Jobs | Workplaces | Work activities |
|---|---|---|
| bank clerk | bank | serve customers, check IDs |
| security guard | shopping centre | check bags, guard the building |
| pharmacist | pharmacy | prepare medicine |
| accountant | office | keep accounts |
| doctor / nurse | hospital | examine / take care of patients |
| teacher | school | teach students |

- **Family members:** cousin (kuzen), nephew (erkek yeğen), niece (kız yeğen), aunt (teyze/hala), uncle (amca/dayı), grandfather…

# Pronunciation

- **o** → /ɒ/ (job, doctor) · /ɔː/ (morning) · /əʊ/ (home, go)
- **m** → /m/ · **n** → /n/ (nurse) ve /ŋ/ (-ing: working) · **p** → /p/

# Skills

- **Reading:** *Divided by Routines, United by Ties* — skimming, scanning, jigsaw, karşılaştırma, çıkarım
- **Writing:** iki aileyi meslek, iş yeri ve aktiviteler açısından karşılaştıran metin
- **CLIL:** *Love Through Traditions* — Türk kültürü, gelenekleri ve değerleri
- **E-Portfolio:** bir aile üyesinin işini konu alan kısa film

ornekler.soru: "My sister's son is my ___. My brother's daughter is my ___."
ornekler.cozum: My sister's son is my **nephew**. My brother's daughter is my **niece**.

ornekler.soru: "He keeps accounts and works in an office." Bu kişinin mesleği nedir?
ornekler.cozum: **Accountant** (muhasebeci).

ozet: nephew = erkek yeğen · niece = kız yeğen · cousin = kuzen.
pharmacist → pharmacy · accountant → office · bank clerk → bank.
-ing sesi /ŋ/.

content.anlatim:
# Reading: A Family of Professionals

*My name is Kerem and my family is very busy. My father is an architect. He designs buildings and he works at an architecture office in the city centre. My mother is a pharmacist. She works at a pharmacy and she serves customers every day. My uncle is a journalist; he reports news for a TV channel. My cousin Elif is a computer programmer. She develops software at an IT company. And me? I want to be a scientist and work in a science lab!*

## Okuma Stratejisi

1. **Before reading:** Başlığa ve ilk cümleye bak, konuyu tahmin et.
2. **Skimming:** Metne hızlıca göz gezdir, ana fikri bul.
3. **Scanning:** Sorulardaki anahtar kelimeleri (isim, sayı, yer) metinde ara.
4. **After reading:** Tahminini kontrol et; bilmediğin kelimelerin anlamını **bağlamdan** çıkar.

# Writing Model

*My aunt is a psychologist. She works at a clinic. She listens to people and helps them with their problems. She starts work at 9.00 and finishes at 5.00. She doesn't work on Sundays. She loves her job because she helps people every day.*

# Performance Task

Ailenden bir kişiyle (ya da bir arkadaşının ailesinden biriyle) **mesleği, iş yeri ve iş rutini** hakkında **mülakat** yap. Sonuçları bir poster ya da kısa film olarak hazırla ve sınıfa sun.

ornekler.soru: What does Kerem's mother do? Where does she work?
ornekler.cozum: She is a **pharmacist**. She **serves customers** at a **pharmacy**.

ornekler.soru: Match the people with their workplaces: father, uncle, Elif.
ornekler.cozum: Father → **architecture office**, uncle → **TV channel** (news agency), Elif → **IT company**.

ozet: Meslek sormak: What does he/she do? / What's his/her job?
Simple Present olumsuz/soru: She doesn't work… / Does he design…?
Prepositions of place: at a bank, in an office, on a social media platform.

content.anlatim:
# Alt temalar

Ev türleri · odalar · mobilya ve ev aletleri · evdeki aktiviteler

# Grammar A — Simple Present ile ev türleri

I **live** in a villa. · She **lives** in a block of flats.

# Grammar B — Present Progressive (Present Continuous)

**Şu anda** ya da bu günlerde süren eylemler.

| Yapı | Örnek |
|---|---|
| (+) **am / is / are + V-ing** | She **is ironing** the clothes right now. · They **are relaxing** in the garden. |
| (−) **am not / isn't / aren't + V-ing** | He **isn't cooking**. |
| (?) **Am / Is / Are + özne + V-ing?** | **Is** she **cooking**? · What **are** you **doing**? |

- Zaman ifadeleri: **now, right now, at the moment, Look!, Listen!, this week**
- -ing kuralları: make → mak**ing** (sessiz -e düşer) · swim → swi**mm**ing (kısa ünlü + ünsüz → ünsüz çiftlenir) · lie → l**ying**

# Grammar C — Possessive adjectives

| Özne | Sahiplik sıfatı | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| I | **my** | This is **my** room. |
| you | **your** | Is this **your** sofa? |
| he | **his** | **His** bedroom is small. |
| she | **her** | **Her** fridge is new. |
| it | **its** | The cat is in **its** basket. |
| we | **our** | **Our** kitchen is large. |
| they | **their** | **Their** garden is large. |

> **its** (sahiplik) ≠ **it's** (it is)

ornekler.soru: Doğru biçimi yazın: "Look! Dad (clean) ___ the windows and Mum (wash) ___ the dishes."
ornekler.cozum: Look! Dad **is cleaning** the windows and Mum **is washing** the dishes.

ornekler.soru: Boşlukları doldurun: "Ali and Elif live in a cottage. ___ house has a big garden. Elif loves ___ bedroom."
ornekler.cozum: **Their** house has a big garden. Elif loves **her** bedroom.

ornekler.soru: Hangisi doğru: "The dog is eating it's / its food."
ornekler.cozum: **its** — sahiplik sıfatı. *it's* = *it is*.

ozet: Present Progressive: am/is/are + V-ing (now, right now, at the moment).
-ing: make → making, swim → swimming.
my, your, his, her, its, our, their.
its ≠ it's.

# Vocabulary

- **Types of houses:** block (of flats), villa, cottage, apartment, detached house…
- **Rooms:** living room, bedroom, bathroom, kitchen, garden, balcony…
- **Furniture & appliances:** bathtub, oven, fridge, pillow, rug, sofa, wardrobe…
- **Activities:** iron, relax, clean, cook, wash, watch TV…

| Eşya | Oda |
|---|---|
| bathtub | bathroom |
| oven, fridge | kitchen |
| pillow, wardrobe | bedroom |
| sofa, rug | living room |

# Pronunciation

- **q** → /k/ (quick: /kw/) · **r** → /r/ · **s** → /s/ · **sh** → /ʃ/ (shower, wash)

# Skills

- **Writing:** ev türleri hakkında metin üretme
- **CLIL:** *Zero-energy buildings* (sıfır enerjili binalar) ve doğayı koruma
- **E-Portfolio:** ev türleri, odalar, mobilya ve aktiviteler hakkında self-recording

ornekler.soru: "cottage" ile "block of flats" arasındaki fark nedir?
ornekler.cozum: **Cottage:** genellikle kırsalda küçük, müstakil ev. **Block of flats:** çok daireli apartman binası.

ornekler.soru: “I'm making my bed in my bedroom now.” cümlesindeki aktivite ve oda kelimelerini bulunuz; *sh* sesini içeren iki ev kelimesi yazınız.
ornekler.cozum: Aktivite: **make the bed**; oda: **bedroom**. *sh* /ʃ/ sesi: **shower**, **wash** (the dishes), **dishwasher**.

ozet: Houses: block of flats, villa, cottage, detached house.
bathtub → bathroom · oven/fridge → kitchen · wardrobe/pillow → bedroom.
sh: /ʃ/.

content.anlatim:
# Reading: Home Sweet Home

*We live in a semi-detached house in a quiet neighbourhood. Our house has three bedrooms, a living room, a kitchen and a small garden. My favourite room is the living room because it is spacious and bright. Right now, my mother is cooking dinner in the kitchen, my father is watering the plants in the garden and my little brother is watching cartoons on the sofa. And me? I'm doing my homework at my desk in my bedroom. Home sweet home!*

## Okuma Stratejisi

1. **Before reading:** Başlığa ve ilk cümleye bak, konuyu tahmin et.
2. **Skimming:** Metne hızlıca göz gezdir, ana fikri bul.
3. **Scanning:** Sorulardaki anahtar kelimeleri (isim, sayı, yer) metinde ara.
4. **After reading:** Tahminini kontrol et; bilmediğin kelimelerin anlamını **bağlamdan** çıkar.

# Writing Model

*I live in a flat on the fourth floor. Our flat has two bedrooms, a living room and a balcony. In my bedroom there is a bed, a wardrobe and a desk. At the moment, I'm sitting on my bed and I'm reading a book. My sister is tidying up her room.*

# Performance Task

Bir sınıf arkadaşınla **ev türleri, odalar, mobilyalar ve evdeki aktiviteler** hakkında konuş. Evini (ya da hayalindeki evi) tanıtan ve şu anda evde kimin ne yaptığını anlatan **bir self-recording** hazırla.

ornekler.soru: What type of house does the writer live in, and what is their favourite room?
ornekler.cozum: A **semi-detached house**. The favourite room is the **living room** because it is **spacious and bright**.

ornekler.soru: What is the writer's father doing at the moment? Which tense is used?
ornekler.cozum: He **is watering the plants** in the garden. **Present Progressive** (am/is/are + verb-ing) is used for actions **happening now**.

ozet: Present Progressive: şu an olan eylemler (I'm doing, she is cooking).
Possessive adjectives: my, your, his, her, its, our, their.
Zaman ifadeleri: now, at the moment, at present.

content.anlatim:
# Alt temalar

Yerel ve uluslararası yemek kültürü · şehirdeki yemek festivalleri

# Grammar A — Simple Present vs Present Progressive

| Simple Present | Present Progressive |
|---|---|
| **Rutin / genel gerçek** | **Şu anda** olan |
| People usually **eat** street food at festivals. | They **are trying** different dishes right now. |
| always, usually, every year, on Sundays | now, right now, at the moment, today |

> Bazı fiiller (**like, love, want, know, need**) genellikle -ing almaz: *I **want** falafel.* (I'm wanting ❌)

# Grammar B — Wh- soruları

- **What do** people **eat** at the festival? (genel)
- **What are** they **cooking** now? (şu an)
- **Where does** the festival **take** place?

# Grammar C — "or" ile seçenek sorma

- **Would you like** Turkish pizza **or** falafel? — I'd like Turkish pizza, please.
- Do you prefer sweet **or** spicy food?

ornekler.soru: Doğru zamanı seçin: "Every September, people (come) ___ to Gaziantep for the festival. This year, my family (visit) ___ it too."
ornekler.cozum: Every September, people **come** (rutin → Simple Present). This year, my family **is visiting** it too (bu dönemde süren eylem → Present Progressive).

ornekler.soru: "or" kullanarak bir seçenek sorusu yazın.
ornekler.cozum: *Would you like boiled beans **or** fried beef?* / *Do you want tea **or** coffee?*

ozet: Simple Present = rutin/gerçek · Present Progressive = şimdi.
like, want, know, need genelde -ing almaz.
Would you like A or B?

# Vocabulary

ornekler.soru: "regional cuisine" ne demektir?
ornekler.cozum: **Yöresel mutfak** — bir bölgeye özgü yemekler ve pişirme gelenekleri.

ornekler.soru: /θ/ ve /ð/ seslerine birer örnek verin.
ornekler.cozum: /θ/: **th**ink, **th**ree · /ð/: **th**e, **th**is, mo**th**er.

content.anlatim:
# Reading: Gaziantep Food Festival

*Every year, Gaziantep hosts an international food festival. Chefs from many countries come and cook their local dishes. This year, I'm at the festival with my family. A chef from Morocco is making couscous, and a Japanese chef is cooking noodles. Local cooks always serve delicious kebabs and baklava. "Is this dish spicy or sweet?" I ask a chef. "It's a bit spicy," he says. Right now, people are tasting dishes, taking photos and listening to music. What a great festival!*

## Okuma Stratejisi

1. **Before reading:** Başlığa ve ilk cümleye bak, konuyu tahmin et.
2. **Skimming:** Metne hızlıca göz gezdir, ana fikri bul.
3. **Scanning:** Sorulardaki anahtar kelimeleri (isim, sayı, yer) metinde ara.
4. **After reading:** Tahminini kontrol et; bilmediğin kelimelerin anlamını **bağlamdan** çıkar.

# Writing Model

*Our city has a local festival every summer. People usually sell street food and handmade souvenirs. Today, I'm at the festival. A cook is preparing gözleme and children are dancing in the square. Is the festival local or international? It's local, but many tourists visit it every year.*

# Performance Task

Bir **yemek festivali programı** tasarla (yerel ve uluslararası yemekler, saatler, etkinlikler) ve sınıfta “festival” düzenle: bazı öğrenciler aşçı/sunucu, bazıları ziyaretçi olsun; *Is it local or international? What are the ingredients?* gibi sorular sorun.

ornekler.soru: Which international dishes are mentioned? Which local food do cooks always serve?
ornekler.cozum: **Couscous** (Morocco) and **noodles** (Japan). Local cooks always serve **kebabs and baklava**.

ornekler.soru: Find one sentence for a routine and one for an action happening now.
ornekler.cozum: Routine (Simple Present): *Every year, Gaziantep **hosts** an international food festival.* Now (Present Progressive): *Right now, people **are tasting** dishes.*

ozet: Simple Present: rutin/gerçek (Every year, the city hosts…); Present Progressive: şu an (A chef is making…).
Seçenek sorma: Is it spicy or sweet? / Is this a local or an international festival?
Tat sıfatları: spicy, salty, sweet, sour, bitter, juicy, creamy.

title.tr: was / were, there was / there were ve should
title.en: was / were, there was / there were and should

content.anlatim:
# Alt temalar

Doğa · nesli tükenen hayvanlar · hayvanların doğal yaşam alanları · nesli tükenen hayvanların korunması

# Grammar A — Verb to be (past): was / were

| Özne | Geçmiş | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| I / He / She / It | **was** | The tiger **was** in danger. |
| You / We / They | **were** | Pandas **were** endangered. |
| (−) | **wasn't / weren't** | It **wasn't** easy. |
| (?) | **Was / Were** + özne…? | **Were** there any shelters? |

# Grammar B — There was / There were

| Tekil / sayılamayan | Çoğul |
|---|---|
| **There was** a shelter for the animals. | **There were** many tigers in the grasslands 50 years ago. |
| **Was there** a shelter? — Yes, there **was**. / No, there **wasn't**. | **Were there** any whales? — Yes, there **were**. / No, there **weren't**. |

# Grammar C — should (tavsiye, öneri, beklenti, zorunluluk)

- (+) We **should protect** wildlife.
- (−) You **should not / shouldn't hunt** illegally.
- (?) **Should** we **create** more shelters?
- *should* + **V1**; tüm öznelerle aynıdır.

ornekler.soru: Boşlukları doldurun: "100 years ago, there ___ many cheetahs in Africa, and there ___ a big forest near the river."
ornekler.cozum: there **were** many cheetahs (çoğul) · there **was** a big forest (tekil).

ornekler.soru: *Should* ile yaban hayatını korumak için iki tavsiye yazın.
ornekler.cozum: *People **should** create more shelters for endangered animals.* / *We **shouldn't** buy products made from wild animals.*

ornekler.soru: Hatayı bulun: "There was many whales in the ocean."
ornekler.cozum: *whales* çoğul → **There were** many whales in the ocean.

ozet: was: I/he/she/it · were: you/we/they.
There was + tekil · There were + çoğul.
should / shouldn't + V1: tavsiye ve öneri.

content.anlatim:
# Vocabulary

- **Animals:** tiger, whale, cheetah, panda…
- **Habitats:** grasslands, oceans, deserts, forests, wildlife…
- **Other:** survive (hayatta kalmak), lessen (azaltmak), shelter (barınak), illegal (yasa dışı), protect (korumak), endangered (nesli tükenmekte olan), awareness (farkındalık)…

# Pronunciation

- **ea** → /ɪə/ (near, year) · **ee** → /iː/ (tree, see)
- **w** → /w/ (whale) · **x** → /ks/ (fox, extinct)

# Skills

- **Reading:** *Türkiye: The Noah's Ark of the World* — skimming, scanning, specific info, gist
- **Writing:** yaban hayatını korumak için **en az üç yol** yazma (*First,… Second,… Finally,…*)
- **CLIL:** doğa, nesli tükenen hayvanlar, habitatlar ve koruma
- **E-Portfolio:** nesli tükenen bir hayvanı tanıtan dijital poster (geçmiş, habitat, görünüm, önem)

ornekler.soru: "endangered" ve "awareness" kelimelerini bir cümlede kullanın.
ornekler.cozum: Örnek: *We should raise **awareness** about **endangered** animals like the panda.*

ornekler.soru: *First, …  Second, …  Finally, …* kalıbıyla yaban hayatını korumanın üç yolunu yazınız.
ornekler.cozum: *First, we should protect animal habitats like forests and oceans. Second, we should stop illegal hunting. Finally, we should reduce plastic pollution.* — Her madde **should** ile öneri bildirir; sıralama sözcükleri metni düzenler.

ozet: Habitats: grasslands, oceans, deserts, forests.
endangered, survive, shelter, illegal, protect, awareness.
ee: /iː/ · ea: /ɪə/ · x: /ks/.

content.anlatim:
# Reading: The Mediterranean Monk Seal

*The Mediterranean monk seal is one of the most endangered sea animals in the world. Fifty years ago, there were monk seals along many coasts of the Mediterranean, but now there are only a few hundred. Their habitats were quiet caves near the sea, but tourism and fishing nets threaten them today. Some seals were caught in nets by accident. What should we do? We should protect their caves, we shouldn't leave plastic on the beaches and we should report any seal we see to the authorities. Every little bit helps!*

## Okuma Stratejisi

1. **Before reading:** Başlığa ve ilk cümleye bak, konuyu tahmin et.
2. **Skimming:** Metne hızlıca göz gezdir, ana fikri bul.
3. **Scanning:** Sorulardaki anahtar kelimeleri (isim, sayı, yer) metinde ara.
4. **After reading:** Tahminini kontrol et; bilmediğin kelimelerin anlamını **bağlamdan** çıkar.

# Writing Model

*The sea turtle is an endangered animal. In the past, there were many sea turtles on Türkiye's beaches, like İztuzu Beach. Their main habitat was the sea and sandy beaches. Today, pollution and bright lights threaten them. We should keep beaches clean and we shouldn't disturb their nests.*

# Performance Task

Nesli tükenmekte olan bir hayvan hakkında arkadaşlarınla **mülakat** yap (geçmişte ve bugün yaşam alanı, tehditler, koruma yolları). Bir **belgesel film metni** yaz ve sınıfta “film gösterimi” düzenle; arkadaşların koruyucu, gönüllü ya da habitata zarar veren rollerini canlandırsın.

ornekler.soru: How many monk seals were there fifty years ago compared with today?
ornekler.cozum: Fifty years ago **there were** monk seals along many coasts; **now there are only a few hundred**.

ornekler.soru: Write two pieces of advice from the text using *should/shouldn't*.
ornekler.cozum: *We **should** protect their caves.* / *We **shouldn't** leave plastic on the beaches.* (also: *We should report any seal we see.*)

ozet: was/were + there was/there were: geçmişteki durum (There were 700,000 leopards…).
should / shouldn't: öneri ve tavsiye.
Habitat, endangered, threaten, protect, survive.

title.tr: Simple Present ile film anlatımı ve Simple Future (will)
title.en: Narrating films with Simple Present; Simple Future (will)

content.anlatim:
# Alt temalar

Filmler · film türleri · fütüristik filmler ve fikirler · teknoloji

# Grammar A — Simple Present ile film özeti

Film ve kitap özetlerinde olaylar genellikle **Simple Present** ile anlatılır:
> In this film, a young scientist **discovers** a new planet. She **builds** a spaceship and **travels** there.

# Grammar B — Simple Future (will)

| Yapı | Örnek |
|---|---|
| (+) **will + V1** | People **will live** on Mars one day. |
| (−) **will not / won't + V1** | Robots **won't replace** all jobs. |
| (?) **Will + özne + V1?** | **Will** robots **replace** teachers? — Yes, they **will**. / No, they **won't**. |

**Kullanım:** geleceğe dair **tahminler (predictions)**, **inançlar (beliefs)**, **beklentiler (expectations)**, **görüşler (opinions)** ve **tahmini fikirler (guesses)**.

Sık kullanılan kalıplar: **I think / I believe / I'm sure / Maybe / Probably** + *will*
> *I think* people **will** travel to space more often in the future.

ornekler.soru: Doğru biçimi yazın: "In 2050, cars (fly) ___ and people (not / drive) ___ them."
ornekler.cozum: In 2050, cars **will fly** and people **won't drive** them.

ornekler.soru: Bir filmin özetini anlatırken hangi zaman kullanılır? Bir örnek verin.
ornekler.cozum: **Simple Present.** *In the film, aliens **attack** the Earth and a group of teenagers **saves** the world.*

ornekler.soru: "Robots / do / our homework" ifadesiyle bir soru ve kısa cevap oluşturun.
ornekler.cozum: **Will** robots **do** our homework? — No, they **won't**. / Yes, they **will**.

ozet: Film özeti → Simple Present.
will / won't + V1: tahmin, inanç, beklenti, görüş.
I think / I believe / probably + will.

content.anlatim:
# Vocabulary

- **Film genres:** comedy, action, cartoon, drama, science fiction…
- **Futuristic themes:** space adventure, robots, alien invasion…
- **Other:** invention, futuristic, discover, technology, space programme…

# Pronunciation

- **/əʊ/ diftongu** farklı yazımlarla: **o** (go), **oe** (toe), **ow** (show), **oa** (boat), **ou** (soul), **eau** (plateau)
- **y** → /j/ (yes, year) veya kelime sonunda /i/ (happy, funny) · **z** → /z/ (zero)

# Skills

- **Reading:** *Türkiye's Roadmap for Growth* — skimming, scanning, jigsaw, karşılaştırma, çıkarım
- **Writing:** bir ülkenin film endüstrisini desteklemesi hakkında metin
- **Culture:** *Türkiye's Space Journey and Future Plans* — Millî Uzay Programı
- **E-Portfolio:** fütüristik film senaryosu yazma ve sınıf içi film gösterimi

ornekler.soru: "alien invasion" temalı bir film hangi türe girer?
ornekler.cozum: **Science fiction** (bilim kurgu); çoğu zaman **action** ögeleri de taşır.

ornekler.soru: /əʊ/ sesini taşıyan farklı yazımlara üç örnek verin.
ornekler.cozum: g**o**, sh**ow**, b**oa**t (ayrıca t**oe**, s**ou**l).

ozet: Genres: comedy, action, cartoon, drama, science fiction.
Futuristic: space adventure, robots, alien invasion.
/əʊ/: o, oe, ow, oa, ou, eau.

content.anlatim:
# Reading: Life in 2070: A Film Review

*"Life in 2070" is a science fiction film about the future. In the film, robots help people at home and at school, and cars fly over the cities. A young scientist invents a time machine and travels to the past. The film is exciting and optimistic. I think people will live on the Moon in the future, but I don't think cars will fly very soon. What will happen in 2070? Nobody knows, but this film is a breath of fresh air!*

## Okuma Stratejisi

1. **Before reading:** Başlığa ve ilk cümleye bak, konuyu tahmin et.
2. **Skimming:** Metne hızlıca göz gezdir, ana fikri bul.
3. **Scanning:** Sorulardaki anahtar kelimeleri (isim, sayı, yer) metinde ara.
4. **After reading:** Tahminini kontrol et; bilmediğin kelimelerin anlamını **bağlamdan** çıkar.

# Writing Model

*My favourite film is an adventure film. In the film, a group of friends explore a mysterious island. The film is exciting and funny. I think technology will change our lives in the future. Robots will do our homework… maybe! Students will learn with virtual reality.*

# Performance Task

Geleceği anlatan **fütüristik bir film senaryosu** yaz (karakterler, mekân, teknoloji, tahminler). Sınıfta bir “film gösterimi” düzenle; arkadaşların oyuncu ve yönetmen rollerini üstlensin.

ornekler.soru: What does the young scientist invent? What genre is the film?
ornekler.cozum: A **time machine**. It is a **science fiction** film.

ornekler.soru: Find one prediction the writer believes and one they don't believe.
ornekler.cozum: Believes: *People **will live** on the Moon in the future.* Doesn't believe: *I don't think cars **will fly** very soon.*

ozet: Simple Future (will): tahmin, inanç, beklenti — Robots will help people.
I think … will … / I don't think … will …
Film anlatırken Simple Present: In the film, a scientist invents…

name.tr: Genel Tekrar: Dilbilgisi Özeti ve Kazanım Kontrol Listesi

title.tr: Genel dilbilgisi özeti ve önemli kalıplar
title.en: General grammar summary and key patterns

content.anlatim:
# Genel Dilbilgisi Özeti

| # | Yapı | Kullanım | Örnek |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Simple Present** | Alışkanlık, rutin, genel gerçek, film özeti, meslek tarifi, ülke tanıtımı | I wake up at 7. / She works in a bank. / The capital is Ankara. |
| 2 | **Present Progressive** | Şu anda / bu günlerde süren eylem | She is cooking dinner right now. |
| 3 | **can** | Yetenek, olasılık, fırsat | I can speak three languages. / You can go hiking there. |
| 4 | **too / enough** | Fazlalık / yeterlilik | too + adj · adj + enough · enough + noun |
| 5 | **was / were, there was / were** | Geçmişte durum ve varlık | There were many cheetahs in Africa 100 years ago. |
| 6 | **should** | Tavsiye, öneri | We should protect endangered animals. |
| 7 | **will** | Gelecek tahmini, inanç, görüş | People will travel to space more often. |
| 8 | **Possessive adjectives** | Sahiplik | my, your, his, her, its, our, their |
| 9 | **Prepositions of place** | Yer | in a bank, at school, on the farm |

### Zaman çizelgesi

**was/were (geçmiş) → Simple Present (her zaman) / Present Progressive (şimdi) → will (gelecek)**

ornekler.soru: Uygun zamanı kullanın: "Last year there (be) ___ only two pandas in the zoo. Now the zookeepers (feed) ___ four pandas, and they think there (be) ___ more next year."
ornekler.cozum: there **were** (geçmiş, çoğul) · the zookeepers **are feeding** (şu an) · there **will be** (gelecek tahmini).

ornekler.soru: Hangi cümle yanlıştır? (a) She can swims. (b) We should recycle. (c) Is he working now?
ornekler.cozum: **(a)** — *can*'den sonra fiil yalın gelir: *She can **swim**.*

Modal (can, should, will) + V1.
too + adj / adj + enough.
